notes.title: Reach New Lights - Development Update
notes.notes:
Hello everyone! 

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40236928/152c2ae22a50dbf876bc2dc2cf1c391f37251655.png 

Flawless Abbey makes sure to stay faithful to its gothic architecture aesthetic -  this latest addition includes new light sources that are beautifully decorated with sparkling colorful glass. Their look is inspired by the turkish glass mosaic lamps, which date back to 200 B.C. !

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40236928/e97db4d067f576da1d5662e600343f2ebb8ba694.png

The new lights are present in the Fair in the first level, making it seem like there is an indoor night sky! Let us know in the comment section what you think! 

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40236928/2610411a3cdecf9b4b3ca51408d980de24e32b54.png

Stay tuned and join us on Twitter and Discord not to miss the updates about the development!
